name: deploy_version_env
label: Release Version Environment Association Table
description: Release version environment association table is used for tracking the status of related releases, statistical time dimensions, and query scenarios for associated data.

fields.name: version_id
fields.description: Version table association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: env_id
fields.description: Environment ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Job ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the version_id, env_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_jobId
indexes.description: Standard index covering the job_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
